notes.title: Final Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I just published the final demo content update, containing the ending to Effera's route and everything leading up to it! This makes the Demo almost its own entire game and way longer than any Demo should reasonably be, but I don't care! I hope you enjoy the ride!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39201071/42eaf9d2ff3927199c385e46743a683d9d903a96.png

Unfortunately, that means all future routes will be locked behind the Beta until the game is closer to completion and ready for an official Early Access release. Please keep in mind that given how slow of a writer I am, this is going to take a while, but I will try my best to make the long wait worth it!

(As always, any support on Ko-fi is truly appreciated, as it makes it slightly less necessary for me to work my regular job and lets me focus more on game development — which in turn will make the game come out faster!)

I really hope you enjoyed what you got to experience so far, and are looking forward to the rest — as there truly is a lot, lot more to come! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39201071/5516c8f45e84576f624750ab53db0349e502a70e.png

Sincerely, thank you to everyone for supporting Artificial Selection so far, whether financially, sharing your theories, reporting bugs, or by telling a friend about it! Every little thing truly makes a difference and makes working on this project so much more fulfilling!

My next steps for 2025 are finishing the ongoing Loye route, and of course, starting a new one! I'll be hosting a poll in my Discord server when that decision comes around, so make sure to join us if you want to help shape the game!

With all that sappiness out of the way, see you in the next one, and happy new year!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39201071/70e2f5522c81ed4e915efe76de1867fe1c3e4234.png

notes.title: Demo Update (0.4.0)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

In preparation of the early access release later this year, I made a few changes to the demo:


 Edited script:
Much of the dialogue has been changed or entirely rewritten to add more depth to the plot and characters.
 Updated graphics:
All characters except for Saeva have new faces, and there's a new UI, title screen, and logo.
 Parallax effect:
The mouse cursor moves the camera around, making characters pop out from the background.
 So many settings:
The game can be customized just how you want it.
 And more!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39201071/2a48764e337abed9800f01a3951e709d84373510.png

However, there has also been a "downgrade", in a sense:

 The demo is significantly shorter now (~30 minutes)

This was done to make the demo easier to maintain. The longer the demo is, the more likely it is that I'll go back and change something - but now, I'm pretty certain what you see in the demo is how it'll be in the final game.

Since the early access launch is still a few months away, I've worked out a compromise for those who are curious about the new screenshots: Insider supporters on Ko-fi or BMAC can play a Beta Version containing the first 3 hours of the game, and tons of new content!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39201071/8238e2f298438d909aeab4cce129964105e34740.png

I'll keep working hard to make the early access release happen.

Thank you for your continued support and patience!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
A few changes were made to the demo, bringing it up to date with how the final game will look.
In terms of content, there isn't anything new, so if you already played the previous version, you don't have to check this one out. But if you haven't, then now is a better time than ever to give it a shot!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39201071/aced48ada19518cfb75aeda428ffa3b19792a6fd.png
List of changes:

 tweaked the UI (hot pink accent, glowing borders, text box redesign)
 added option to change text box opacity
 changed the main menu layout (bye, Saeva!)
 changed the game menu layout
 at last, a functional custom cursor
 added new sound effects
 optimized image loading; skipping should be much smoother now
 integrated Discord Rich Presence

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39201071/d5207774d6931968f796f1c618c2cf0add39ebb7.png

I hope you'll enjoy these subtle improvements, and thank you for your support!
